event_description:
OGEEEZ - A Comedy Variety Show is an overload of various comedy acts wrapped up into one night of non stop laughter. Hosted by Don Dario, the creator, writer, editor, director, producer and one of the hosts of The DUM Podcast on YouTube. Don brings the ‘funny’ on air and on stage throughout the SoCal comedy scene. With various off-the-wall acts between stand up comedy, this show promises entertainment at all costs! So purchase tickets now and let’s get crazy!

Comics:

Don Dario (Host)
As the creator, writer, editor, director, producer and one of the hosts of The DUM Podcast on YouTube, Don Dario brings the ‘funny’ on air and on stage throughout the SoCal & Phoenix valley comedy scenes. Known for his crazy unique Mexican flare and his ‘Grip It & Rip It’ parenting skills, Don loves delivering belly jiggling laughs to his audience. If he’s not sounding off with a proud grito, you can catch Don Dario saying, “Have Fun in Life Folks” and “Get Ready Cuz Here We Go!!!!”

Tony Garcia (Opener)
Sushi chef by day comedian by night, San Diego based comedian with 5 years of experience making people laugh with witty jokes and a playful vibe, stand up dates on my Instagram or catch me at my regular Sunday improv show at National Comedy theater.

Mimi Harris (Feature)
Boston-born and San Diego-based, MiMi Harris tells it like it is—loudly, bluntly, and with zero follow-up apology. A nurse for a decade before stepping into comedy, she got her start the hard way: delivering her dad’s eulogy as her first open mic… and absolutely killing.
Blending high-octane ADHD energy with sharp deadpan, MiMi plays the “dumb blonde” while quietly being the smartest (and possibly toughest) person in the room. Her comedy is raw, real, a little unhinged, and always honest.

Adam Dominguez (Headliner)
Adam has always been a smartass. A former A/B Honor Roll student from the borderland city of El Paso, TX, Adam Dominguez's lust for life and penchant for captivating storytelling has created a quick-witted, heartfelt, and hilarious comedian honed with over a decade of experience. Adam's talents drew him to Las Vegas, the Entertainment Capital of the World, where he quickly carved himself into one of the most trusted names in stand up comedy and consequently winning awards like the "Funniest Person in the Universe" in 2023, and even the ComedyReviewers called him the "Nonchalant Comedic Genius".

Adam's tales of optimistic deviancy and ne'er-do-wells have left their marks on comey clubs on the famous Vegas Strip to the World Famous Comedy Store, to the stages of the "new mecca" in Austin, TX. Adam has also appeared on Amazon Prime with Laugh After Dark: Live in Las Vegas and OFTv by Onlyfans' "LMAOF" (Episode 3). Dominguez is also a Best of Fest Winner for Laugh After Dark ComedyFest, selected performer for Skankfest Vegas, and has been invited to perform with comedy legends and powerhouses like Rich Vos, Steph Tolev, Adam Carolla, Orny Adams, Brian Regan, Dov Davidoff, Pablo Francisco, Martin Moreno, Bret Ernst, and so much more! Not bad for a kid who almost didn't graduate.

event_description:
Chris Kattan is best known as one of the longest serving cast members on NBC’s SATURDAY NIGHT LIVE. In the 8 years Chris starred in the landmark late night program, he became best known for his characters ‘Mango,’ ‘Mr Peepers,’ and one of the ‘Butabi Brothers’ opposite Will Ferrell which was such a hit that the sketch was adapted into the 1998 cult classic, NIGHT AT THE ROXBURY. Kattan went on to star in CORKY ROMANO where he plays the black sheep son in a family of mobsters and played the villain in the Malcolm D. Lee film, UNDERCOVER BROTHER, opposite Eddie Griffin. Kattan starred as a series regular in the ABC hit series, THE MIDDLE, and recently had some memorable appearances in the Adam Sandler films HOTEL TRANSYLVANIA and THE RIDICULOUS 6. Kattan trained at Los Angeles’ The Groundlings Theater is one of its most famous alumni. He currently tours the country with his extremely popular stand-up act.

Ages 21+

event_description:
Chris Kattan is best known as one of the longest serving cast members on NBC’s SATURDAY NIGHT LIVE. In the 8 years Chris starred in the landmark late night program, he became best known for his characters ‘Mango,’ ‘Mr Peepers,’ and one of the ‘Butabi Brothers’ opposite Will Ferrell which was such a hit that the sketch was adapted into the 1998 cult classic, NIGHT AT THE ROXBURY. Kattan went on to star in CORKY ROMANO where he plays the black sheep son in a family of mobsters and played the villain in the Malcolm D. Lee film, UNDERCOVER BROTHER, opposite Eddie Griffin. Kattan starred as a series regular in the ABC hit series, THE MIDDLE, and recently had some memorable appearances in the Adam Sandler films HOTEL TRANSYLVANIA and THE RIDICULOUS 6. Kattan trained at Los Angeles’ The Groundlings Theater is one of its most famous alumni. He currently tours the country with his extremely popular stand-up act.

Ages 21+

event_description:
Does your child have a knack for making people laugh? Enroll them in our six-week stand-up comedy workshop designed for kids ages 8 to 15 years old at Mic Drop Comedy! This fun and engaging program will help them develop a 5-minute set to perform in front of family and friends at the end of the course.

Each week, our interactive workshops will cover essential comedy topics, including:

  • Stage presence
  • Comedy terminology
  • Writing techniques
  • Joke structure
  • Storytelling
  • Finding their “voice”

Led by professional stand-up comedians, this course simulates a small show environment, giving each student the opportunity to be on stage during every session. The workshops are designed to be fun, supportive, and an amazing resource for young aspiring comedians.

The six week course wraps up with a special performance where students can showcase their new skills in front of a live audience of family and friends. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to help your child/grandchild build confidence, creativity, and a love for comedy. Sign up today and let the laughter begin!

Classes (90 mins):

Sep 20, Sep 27, Oct 4, Oct 18, Oct 25, Nov 1

Makeup Class: Nov 15

Final Showcase Event: Nov 22 @ 3:00 pm

Students should bring a spiral notebook or journal to write in. For questions please email Camille@MicDropComedy.com

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.

Stand Up Comedy Class at Mic Drop Comedy!

Join our six week stand up comedy class, and develop a 5 minute set that you can perform at open mics and live shows!

Every week will be an interactive class that will cover different topics.

This class covers:

Stage presence

How to deal with hecklers

Comedy terminology

Writing techniques

Joke structure

Story telling

Finding your “voice”

event_description:
Damon Williams, the legendary comedian, actor, writer, and producer, is a native of Chicago who has become a household name in the entertainment industry for over 30 years. Williams' journey to stardom began as a young entrepreneur, owning a Subway sandwich shop in the early '90s. However, he caught the comedy bug, and since then, he hasn't looked back.

Over the years, Williams has worked with some of the most iconic stars in show business, too many to mention. He has performed stand-up comedy on several networks, including numerous television appearances. Williams' reputation as a highly sought-after comedian led to him earning the opening spot on the legendary Kings of Comedy Tour and touring the US on the Royal Comedy Tour.

event_description:
The business of comedy changes very often, and yet the one thing that stays consistent is hilarity. Edwin San Juan is a seasoned comedy veteran who has proven his consistency and hilarity onstage, garnering San Juan with awards, acclaim, and further cementing Edwin as one of the funniest working comedians with credit and tenure. Equipped with his multicultural life experiences, his observational humor and wordplay, and finding the humor in stereotypes, Edwin is currently the longest running stand-up comedian headliner in Las Vegas with his home at the Las Vegas Live Comedy Club, and also a recipient of Las Vegas Weekly's Best Comedian on The Strip award.

San Juan is the creator and executive producer of "SlantED Comedy," a showcase of Asian American stand-up comedians televised on Showtime and also appeared in "I'm Not Like That No More" (2010), a feature film comedy co-starring Felipe Esparza and Paul Rodriguez. Edwin was featured on 'Gabriel Iglesias' Presents Stand-Up Revolution' on Comedy Central and even joined Iglesias on a USO Tour-based "Around the World in Eight Days". San Juan has also appeared on Comedy Central's 'Live at Gotham', 'Comics without Borders' on Showtime, ' The Payaso Comedy Slam' on both Showtime and Comedy Central, Comics Unleashed with Byron Allen on ABC, UPN's 'Live from Hollywood', BET’s Comic View, Galavision’s 'Que Locos' & 'Loco Comedy Jam', Si TV’s 'Latino Laugh Festival', 'Inside Joke' and 'Latino 101', 'Destination Stardom' on NBC, 'International Sexy Ladies Show' on G4 TV and also reigned as the grand champion of the 'Talent Agency' on UPN with 9 consecutive victories.

event_description:
Lady Bushra brings her new live show Professional Victim to Mic Drop Comedy San Diego for one day only! A sharp, fast-moving hour of stand-up from one of the UK’s most distinctive emerging comedy voices.

Originally from Bradford, England and now based in the U.S., Lady Bushra is the drag persona of comedian Amir Dean, blending British observational comedy with political satire, immigrant storytelling and brutally honest cultural commentary. As seen on BBC, Channel 4, Revry TV and shortlisted for the BBC New Comedy Award, Bushra has quickly built an international audience online and on stage through a style that feels closer to modern stand-up than traditional drag performance.

The material being developed in this performance forms part of Bushra’s upcoming comedy special; a theatrical stand-up project exploring identity, migration, religion, family and modern culture through the perspective of a British South Asian comic trying to make sense of America.

Expect a tightly written hour covering everything from growing up in a conservative Muslim household in Northern England to navigating queer life in New York and Los Angeles, all delivered with dry British timing, audience interaction and an instinct for finding the absurd in both progressive and conservative culture alike.

No lip-syncs. No death drops. Just stand-up comedy from a performer rapidly becoming one of the most original voices working between the UK and U.S. comedy scenes.

Whether you're in menopause, approaching it, supporting someone through it, or simply curious about what happens to sex after 40, this show is for you!

Join Taylor Stafford, Nurse Practitioner at San Diego Menopause and sex educator, along with a lineup of hilarious stand-up comedians for an evening of comedy, candid conversation, and expert sex education. Because menopause doesn't mean the fun is over. It just gets more interesting after dark.”

event_description:
Get ready for a special girls’ night out presented by Group Chat Girlies.

Skylar Schock and Carol Tyner host a one-of-a-kind evening made just for the girlies.

Enjoy stand up comedy, interactive segments, and unpacking what's in the group chat. We plan to “spill the tea”, share recommendations, discuss pop culture and more. Think your group chat — but in person, on stage, with plenty of audible gasps and laughs.

Girlie fight club is here.

Skylar Schock and Carol Tyner are known for their sharp, relatable takes on dating, friendship, and all things girlhood. This show blends comedy and conversations in a unique format.

Skylar is a bi-coastal stand-up comic, actor, writer, and producer. She has performed across the country at venues including The Comedy Store (La Jolla), Jimmy Kimmel’s Comedy Club (Las Vegas), and the Laugh After Dark stage. She's opened for headliners including Cristina Mariani, Michael Yo, John Caparulo, and Ivy Wolk. Skylar was a Best of Fest selection at the Comedy Chateau Comedy Festival (LA), an official performer at the Queen City Comedy Experience (CLT) and advanced in the WSOC (ATL and Ohio). She is the creator of Group Chat Girlies, a unique format live show, and Laugh Until You Cry, a stand-up show spotlighting mental health. Film credits include For the Love of Lily and the Austin Film Fest Award-winning short Betsy F*ing Ross.

Carol Tyner is a stand-up comedian, improviser, and producer. Carol has performed at comedy clubs including The Idiot Box Comedy Club, The Comedy Club at Duckworth’s, The Comedy Zone (Charlotte & Greenville). She has opened for headliners including Tim Meadows, Erica Rhodes, Cliff Cash, Cam Bertrand, and Conner King. Carol has been a featured performer in festivals including: The North Carolina Comedy Festival, The Queen City Comedy Experience,, The NewSouth Comedy Festival, and The Asheville Comedy Festival. She is a founding cast member of the award-winning Shameless Improv Society. Carol also co-produces Group Chat Girlies, a live comedy show that mixes stand-up with interactive audience segments driving women-led conversations. In addition, she co-creates The Lynns, a character-driven sketch duo, and We Rate Your Run, a (wo)man-on-the-street social series known for its quick, off-the-cuff humor.

Bring your group chat or find a new one!

event_description:
Los Mojados comedy show vuelve en gloria y majestad al Micdrop SD despues de una pequeña pausa. Este show traera a los mejores comediantes en español de USA y Latinoamerica. Donde nuestra Raza podra disfrutar comedia en nuestro idioma natal! Porque la comedia en Español se vive y disfruta aca sin limites, abriendo nuevamente los unicos espacios para comedia en Español en el area de San Diego y alrededores.

El show producido y hosteado por nuestro querido Leo Saavedra, el es un comediante chileno radicado en Estados Unidos por 20 años. En sus ocho años haciendo comedia se ha presentado en Rusia, México, Chile, Puerto Rico y todo USA. Ha sido abridor de los shows de reconocidos comediantes en Norteamérica como Felipe Esparza, Richard Villa, Paul Rodriguez y muchos más.

Es uno de los comediantes frecuentes en los míticos Comedy Store y Laught Factory, con un record de 8-7-2 en los Roast Battles del Comedy Store LA. Seleccionado en el New York Underground comedy Festival, finalista del AMG Comedy Festival, San Diego Comedy Festival y se presenta regularmente en los más importantes clubes de comedia en California. Ha presentado su trabajo en la televisión estadounidense: Vision Latina TV, CBS y más.

Productor y creador de Muy Funny Latino Comedy Show @Mic Drop Comedy Club (Ingles) con comediantes exclusivamente latinos. Un comediante Chileno que ya está dando que hablar a nivel internacional.

event_description:
Does your child have a knack for making people laugh? Enroll them in our six-week stand-up comedy workshop designed for kids ages 8 to 15 years old at Mic Drop Comedy! This fun and engaging program will help them develop a 5-minute set to perform in front of family and friends at the end of the course.

Each week, our interactive workshops will cover essential comedy topics, including:

  • Stage presence
  • Comedy terminology
  • Writing techniques
  • Joke structure
  • Storytelling
  • Finding their “voice”

Led by professional stand-up comedians, this course simulates a small show environment, giving each student the opportunity to be on stage during every session. The workshops are designed to be fun, supportive, and an amazing resource for young aspiring comedians.

The six week course wraps up with a special performance where students can showcase their new skills in front of a live audience of family and friends. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to help your child/grandchild build confidence, creativity, and a love for comedy. Sign up today and let the laughter begin!

Classes (90 mins):

Sep 20, Sep 27, Oct 4, Oct 18, Oct 25, Nov 1

Makeup Class: Nov 15

Final Showcase Event: Nov 22 @ 3:00 pm

Students should bring a spiral notebook or journal to write in. For questions please email Camille@MicDropComedy.com

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.

Josh Gondelman is a writer and comedian who incubated in Boston before moving to New York City, where he currently lives and most recently worked as the head writer and an executive producer for Desus & Mero on Showtime. Previously, he spent five years at Last Week Tonight with John Oliver, first as a web producer and then as a staff writer where he earned four Emmy Awards, two Peabody Awards, and three WGA Awards. Josh also previously wrote for Fuse TV’s Billy On The Street.

His most recent hour, Positive Reinforcement, is now available to stream. Josh’s debut standup special People Pleaser was released in 2022. In 2016, Josh made his late-night standup debut on Conan (TBS), and he has also performed on Late Night With Seth Meyers (NBC) and The Late Late Show with James Corden (CBS).

Gondelman is the author of the essay collection Nice Try: Stories of Best Intentions and Mixed Results published September 2019 by Harper Perennial. Since 2019, he has been a regular panelist on NPR mainstay Wait Wait Don’t Tell Me.

Offstage, Gondelman is also the co-author (along with Joe Berkowitz) of the book You Blew It, published October 2015 by Plume. His writing has also appeared in prestigious publications such as McSweeney’s Internet Tendency, New York Magazine, and The New Yorker.

This class will be an interactive atmosphere with a strong focus on writing to develop new material, live performing, as well as booking and navigating yourself through the scene.

event_description:
Does your child have a knack for making people laugh? Enroll them in our six-week stand-up comedy workshop designed for kids ages 8 to 15 years old at Mic Drop Comedy!   • Comedy terminology
  • Writing techniques
  • Joke structure
  • Storytelling
  • Finding their “voice”

The six week course wraps up with a special performance where students can showcase their new skills in front of a live audience of family and friends. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to help your child/grandchild build confidence, creativity, and a love for comedy. Sign up today and let the laughter begin!

event_description:
J.B. Ball is proving himself to be quite the jack of all trades in comedy. He’s found success as a stand-up comedian, tv writer, sketch writer, performer, director, and producer. He masks being deceptively edgy and intelligent with playful charm. His ability to bring the funny out of controversial topics for people on both sides of an issue brings audiences together with humor.

His work can be seen on Comedy Central, MTV, PEACOCK, NBC, CBS, COMCAST, SIRIUS/XM Satellite Radio, Kevin Hart's LOL Network, and as a Segment Producer of the hit show Ridiculousness.

He’s also making waves as a writer after the success of Olympic Highlights w/ Kevin Hart and Snoop Dogg along with his sketch on Comedy Central Digital “Who’s the GOAT: MJ or Lebron”.

As a stand-up comedian he was selected for the prestigious "New Faces" at the 2016 Montreal Just For Laughs Festival, was the winner of the 2014 Trial By Laughter Comedy Festival, was named 2014's "Florida's Funniest Comedian”, performed at FunnyOrDie’s 2015 Oddball Comedy Festival, and was a finalist at the 2016 Laughing Skull Festival.

In 2020, he released a comedy music project Ball4President, titled after his social media name, complete with music video sketches for each song.

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.

event_description:
Madison Walser is a comedian, writer, and producer originally from Texas, now based in Los Angeles. Her observational style pulls from dating, politics, religion, and the general chaos of being a woman with "too many" opinions. Her unique humor often discusses why social norms are kind of weird and incorporates a dark twang.

Madison co-created and produced the Heated Rivalry Comedy Show and hosts Doctor Walser, a podcast where she and her dad turn uncomfortable medical conversations into surprisingly comfortable ones. She recenlty founded a company, PUTRE, to help audiences discover film, TV, and stand-up from indie creators. She has been featured in CNN, WSJ, and NY Mag for her satirical work.

event_description:
Jamie Shriner is what would happen if Bo Burnham and Jenna Marbles were cryogenically frozen together in a pair of cat lady glasses. A former theatre kid, current queer & hard of hearing divorcé, Jamie uses humorous original songs to discuss her struggles with divorce, body image, hearing loss, womanhood, and being queer in Indiana where she grew up.

Jamie was named Best of the Fest at Kenan Thompson’s Road To New York, Big Pine Comedy Festival, Laughs After Dark Comedy Festival and is a regular feature at Zanies and Laugh Factory Chicago. The host and producer of Cast Party has opened for the likes of Beth Stelling, Randy Feltface, and Chrissy Chlapecka, and is a former Features Contributor for The Onion. Her comedy specials, Corn Baby, Good Grief, and The Nightmare Factory are available to stream on YouTube, Spotify, iTunes, and more.

event_name: ROBYN SCHALL: JUST MARRIED COMEDY TOUR
event_description:
Social media's favorite funny lady, Robyn Schall, is going straight from the altar to the comedy club. Who needs a honeymoon when there are jokes and stories to tell? Fresh off her wedding, Robyn is hitting the road with her Just Married Comedy Tour, sharing hilarious behind-the-scenes moments, outrageous wedding stories, audience interaction, and all the chaos that comes with planning a wedding and starting married life. Whether you've followed Robyn for years or are discovering her for the first time, get ready for a one-of-a-kind night of stand-up, surprises, and laughs.

Robyn Schall is a stand-up comedian, actress, and host whose "2020 Goals List" video went viral, garnering more than 10 million views and praise from Oprah, The Kardashians, Jennifer Garner, and Katie Couric. Robyn served as the digital correspondent on NBC's The Kelly Clarkson Show for its final three seasons. Prior to that, she hosted Betches Media's weekly advice podcast Call Waiting and Pinterest TV's live-streaming show The Goods. She now hosts the comedy podcast Schall We Talk, where you never know what will unfold. Robyn has also hosted segments and interviews for Katie Couric Presents and has appeared on The Drew Barrymore Show, Sherri Shepard Show, and Watch What Happens Live! Robyn has performed stand-up all over the world, including three overseas tours entertaining U.S. troops, with performances throughout Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Australia. Her comedy album, Guilty Pleasure, debuted at #1 on the iTunes Comedy Charts and has been featured multiple times on SiriusXM. Robyn is currently touring the country with her live, interactive comedy shows.

event_description:
Shawn Wayans made his acting debut in 1989 in his brother Keenen Ivory Wayans’ feature film “I’m Gonna Get You Sucka.” Immediately following his feature film debut, Shawn joined the cast of the Emmy Award winning comedy series, “In Living Color.”

Shawn starred in the box office hits, “Little Man” and “White Chicks,” both of which he also co-wrote and co-executive produced. Shawn began co-writing his string of blockbusters with the smash “Scary Movie” where he also played Ray, an ambiguously gay football jock, alongside his brother Marlon Wayans, and directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans. Co-written, co-executive produced by and starring Shawn Wayans, “Scary Movie 2” was the only sequel in the “Scary Movie” franchise with direct Wayans involvement. Shawn will next be seen on the big screen in “Dance Flick,” the new comedy co-written with brothers Marlon and Keenen Ivory, premiering in February 2009.

Shawn’s past film credits include the hit comedy “Don’t Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in The Hood,” which he co- wrote, executive produced and starred in with brother Marlon Wayans. The movie was a comic spoof of the coming-of-age-in-the-‘hood movies and is a huge cult favorite.

“The Wayans Bros.” sitcom, which Shawn and Marlon created and starred in, was the first WB show to be sold into syndication after heading up the WB network lineup for five years.

In 2006, Shawn, along with his brothers and sisters created The Boo Crew animated specials for Nickelodeon is about nine inner city kids from diverse backgrounds where lessons are learned through real world situations infused with comedy and music. In addition to creating, Shawn also wrote, produced, directed and voicing the series for the revival with new episodes on its YouTube channel, The Boo Crew TV.

When not on the road performing stand up, Shawn can be found hard at work in the “lab” where he and his brothers are busy concocting their next project.

Crickette Gill is a dynamic force in stand-up, known for her relatable wit and fearless charm. Crickette is captivating audiences all across the Southwest with her dark sense of humor—and for her, Friday the 13th is the perfect day to do it. Shawn starred in the box office hits, “Little Man” and “White Chicks,” both of which he also co-wrote and co-executive produced. Shawn began co-writing his string of blockbusters with the smash “Scary Movie” where he also played Ray, an ambiguously gay football jock, alongside his brother Marlon Wayans, and directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans. Co-written, co-executive produced by and starring Shawn Wayans, “Scary Movie 2” was the only sequel in the “Scary Movie” franchise with direct Wayans involvement. Shawn will next be seen on the big screen in “Dance Flick,” the new comedy co-written with brothers Marlon and Keenen Ivory, premiering in February 2009.

Shawn’s past film credits include the hit comedy “Don’t Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in The Hood,” which he co- wrote, executive produced and starred in with brother Marlon Wayans. The movie was a comic spoof of the coming-of-age-in-the-‘hood movies and is a huge cult favorite.

“The Wayans Bros.” sitcom, which Shawn and Marlon created and starred in, was the first WB show to be sold into syndication after heading up the WB network lineup for five years.

In 2006, Shawn, along with his brothers and sisters created The Boo Crew animated specials for Nickelodeon is about nine inner city kids from diverse backgrounds where lessons are learned through real world situations infused with comedy and music. In addition to creating, Shawn also wrote, produced, directed and voicing the series for the revival with new episodes on its YouTube channel, The Boo Crew TV.

In Santa Monica, Macey hosts The Picture Day Show, a popular stand-up comedy showcase at The Crow. She also co-hosts the mental health and comedy podcast SSRI’M OK with Dr. Bijan Zarrabi, where they explore mental health topics alongside expert guests and fellow comedians.

Shawn starred in the box office hits, “Little Man” and “White Chicks,” both of which he also co-wrote and co-executive produced. Shawn began co-writing his string of blockbusters with the smash “Scary Movie” where he also played Ray, an ambiguously gay football jock, alongside his brother Marlon Wayans, and directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans. Co-written, co-executive produced by and starring Shawn Wayans, “Scary Movie 2” was the only sequel in the “Scary Movie” franchise with direct Wayans involvement. Shawn will next be seen on the big screen in “Dance Flick,” the new comedy co-written with brothers Marlon and Keenen Ivory, premiering in February 2009.

Shawn’s past film credits include the hit comedy “Don’t Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in The Hood,” which he co- wrote, executive produced and starred in with brother Marlon Wayans. The movie was a comic spoof of the coming-of-age-in-the-‘hood movies and is a huge cult favorite.

“The Wayans Bros.” sitcom, which Shawn and Marlon created and starred in, was the first WB show to be sold into syndication after heading up the WB network lineup for five years.

In 2006, Shawn, along with his brothers and sisters created The Boo Crew animated specials for Nickelodeon is about nine inner city kids from diverse backgrounds where lessons are learned through real world situations infused with comedy and music. In addition to creating, Shawn also wrote, produced, directed and voicing the series for the revival with new episodes on its YouTube channel, The Boo Crew TV.

When not on the road performing stand up, Shawn can be found hard at work in the “lab” where he and his brothers are busy concocting their next project.

event_description:
Does your child have a knack for making people laugh? Enroll them in our six-week stand-up comedy workshop designed for kids ages 8 to 15 years old at Mic Drop Comedy! This fun and engaging program will help them develop a 5-minute set to perform in front of family and friends at the end of the course.

Each week, our interactive workshops will cover essential comedy topics, including:

  • Stage presence
  • Comedy terminology
  • Writing techniques
  • Joke structure
  • Storytelling
  • Finding their “voice”

Led by professional stand-up comedians, this course simulates a small show environment, giving each student the opportunity to be on stage during every session. The workshops are designed to be fun, supportive, and an amazing resource for young aspiring comedians.

The six week course wraps up with a special performance where students can showcase their new skills in front of a live audience of family and friends. Don’t miss this incredible opportunity to help your child/grandchild build confidence, creativity, and a love for comedy. Sign up today and let the laughter begin!

Classes (90 mins):

Sep 20, Sep 27, Oct 4, Oct 18, Oct 25, Nov 1

Makeup Class: Nov 15

Final Showcase Event: Nov 22 @ 3:00 pm

Students should bring a spiral notebook or journal to write in. For questions please email Camille@MicDropComedy.com

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.

event_description:
Psychic standup is a one of a kind show where Karen Rontowski combines her 35 years as a stand-up comedian with 25 years as a tarot reader and the results are so funny it's scary!

Part standup and part live readings for the crowd, fun is had by believers and non-believers alike. (Though Karen may just have you believing in everything by the end of the night!)

ABOUT KAREN:

Karen Rontowski's fast-paced, quirky and charmingly optimistic comedy has been featured in clubs, TV, radio, and at corporate events all around the world.

Her stand-up showcases endearing, self-effacing and intelligent characters that catch you by surprise every time. Karen uniquely blends comedy with her experience as a Paranormal Investigator, Tarot and reiki master.

Karen has appeared on The Late Show with David Letterman, Sirius Satellite Radio, Comics Unleashed, Comedy.com, Live at Gotham, Comedy Central and Mysteries of the Unexplained. You can see her Dry Bar Comedy Special called Ridiculous Me on VidAngel.com where it just received over 20 million hit and was also a Paranormal Panelist at the Los Angeles ComicCon.

After performing and hosting at paranormal conventions all over the world she created the hilariously odd web series Paranormal Karen where she has fun reporting from haunted and obscure places everywhere. She also has an in-depth podcast by the same name.

Read more about Karen at www.karenrontowski.com!

With 5M+ renters paying their rent with Bilt every month, we now represent 1 in 4 residential buildings nationwide. Paying rent through Bilt allows our residents to earn points on rent and all around their neighborhood doing the things they love, plus attend neighborhood experiences unlocked with their points. As champions of the neighborhood, it’s only natural that we bring the comedy scene closer to home while spotlighting the best local talent. We're getting our members off their couches and into the spots where comedy magic happens.

OUR PASSION FOR COMEDY EXPLAINED

Comedy isn't just entertainment—it's the heartbeat of neighborhood culture. We're excited to bolster the voices that make each community unique and bring members together through laughter. We're on a mission to ignite the local comedy scene by connecting clubs and their comics with residents right in their neighborhoods. Why? Because we believe the next comedy breakthrough is probably performing just blocks from where you live—and we're going to help you discover them!

event_description:
Ali Macofsky is a stand up comedian, actress, and writer who began her comedy career at the age of 7 when she would join Ryan Seacrest on KIIS FM every weekday morning and prank call listeners as her character “Lil Ally” and has continued to pursue comedy ever since. Shortly after high school, Ali quickly established herself in the Los Angeles comedy scene where she became the first regular to perform on over 100 episodes of the Comedy Store’s weekly Kill Tony podcast. This provided further opportunities leading Ali to headline venues across the country, as well as open for huge names in the comedy world like Russell Peters and Joe Rogan. Most recently, Ali was named a New Face of Comedy at the Just for Laughs Comedy festival in Montreal. She also just completed a tour opening for rock musician, St. Vincent. Ali’s stand up has been featured on Just For Laughs digital receiving over 3 million views and her stand up has been seen on TikTok over 10 million times. She has a popular series on her Instagram (@notalimac) where she talks to strangers online and she hosts a weekly podcast called Resting Bitch. Ali’s voice on and off stage has captured a wide range of fans who gravitate toward her honest, relatable sense of humor and unique perspective on life.

event_description:
Advanced Stand Up Comedy Class at Mic Drop Comedy! Join our advanced six week stand up comedy class, and add new material to your existing set. Every week will be an interactive class that will cover different topics. This is for anyone that has already started stand up comedy as well as former students of the intro to stand up class! This class will be an interactive atmosphere with a strong focus on writing to develop new material, live performing, as well as booking and navigating yourself through the scene.

This course is led by a professional stand up comedians with years of experience. The class simulates a small show environment that gives each student an opportunity to be on stage each session. Much like the intro class, there will be a final live showcase, each student will perform for at least 8 minutes!

This series of classes meets each week on Saturdays from 10am-12pm beginning Oct 10. The classes will take place on the following dates Oct 10, Oct 17, Oct 24, Oct 31, Nov 14, and final class is Nov 21. The classes will culminate with the student showcase on Saturday, Nov 28 in front of a live audience in the Main Room at Mic Drop Comedy San Diego.

For more details please email Jesse Egan @ jesseegancomedy@gmail.com.

event_description:
Kelly Collette is a stand-up comedian featured on SiriusXM, NPR, Amazon Prime, Apple TV, Dry Bar Comedy, and the LMOAF Network.

She is a recurring guest and guest host on The Bob & Tom Show.

Kelly headlines clubs, theaters, and festivals nationwide, including Big Sky Comedy Festival, San Francisco Sketchfest, Limestone Comedy Festival, Laughing Skull Comedy Festival, Flyover Comedy Festival and Gilda’s LaughFest (best of the Midwest).

She was a finalist on CMT’s Next Big Comic, toured with The Nobodies of Comedy, was named Cincinnati CityBeat’s Best Comedian (2000 and 2025) and has emceed for the Cincinnati Reds.

In addition to stand-up, Kelly made history as the first-ever stand-up comedian selected as an Artist in Residence in the U.S. National Parks program, creating original work inside national parks and bringing comedy into spaces it had never existed before.

She’s written plays for Fringe Festivals, pop up experiences for Pan Am Airlines, a children’s book for kids for anxiety, and has gotten a cease and assist letter from Quentin Tarantino‘s lawyer about her play Reservoir Dames.

event_description:
T. Murph is an American comedian, actor, and writer that broke out of the Chicago comedy scene and has been quickly rising ever since.

T. Murph currently stars in Hulu's new comedy series, WOKE alongside Lamorne Morris, Rose McIver, Blake Anderson and Sasheer Zamata. The show is inspired by the life and work of African American cartoonist Keith Knight. WOKE is remarkably unique in its blend of comedy, socially conscious storytelling, and in including expertly deployed flights of unexpected animation. T. Murph stars as ‘Clovis,’ a character who is part of the show's central trio and brings an original perspective and voice to the series.

A true powerhouse onscreen and onstage, T. Murph has toured extensively across the country’s most prominent comedy clubs, colleges, and festivals, and has performed at the NBC Diversity Finals Showcase, HBO's American Black Film Festival, New York Comedy Festival, Just For Laughs, and the Second City Breakout Festival, among countless others.

T. Murph has been hailed as “scene-stealing and hilarious” by ENTERTAINMENT WEEKLY, “the most consistently funny aspect of the show” by THE NEW YORK TIMES, and “the breakout... who steals every scene he’s in” by INDIEWIRE. Since the premiere of "Woke,’ it has helped spark important social conversations.

T. Murph’s notable Television credits include SATURDAY NIGHT LIVE, KEY & PEELE, COMEDY' CENTRAL's KEVIN HART: THE NEXT LEVEL, EPIX, GET SHORTY, NBC'S CHICAGO FIRE, and BET's COMIC VIEW, among others.

event_description:
Long Island native, Michael Quu, planted his seeds in comedy in the 7th grade by winning a comedy writing contest, it would be years later that Michael began performing stand up in New York City. He honed his skills at clubs and open mics winning several local comedy contests before finally moving to Los Angeles where he quickly became a club favorite.

Now he's one of the premiere touring stand up acts in the US and Canada. Full of energy, Michael Quu delivers huge laughs with quick paced stories about his personal life and quirky observations. His broad comedy appeal garners him fans of all ages and backgrounds providing an entertaining experience for anyone from 18 to 80.

Michael Quu is the host of the Learn Something New podcast. Each episode Quu seeks to be educated on trending topics through in depth conversations with the world's leading subject matter experts. Interviews include: NY times bestselling authors, FBI agents, multimillionaire entrepreneurs and renowned behavior psychologists.

event_description:
Shapel Lacey is a Los Angeles based comedian born and raised in Mesa, Arizona. A diehard punk rocker and former award-winning competitive cheerleader, Shapel found ways to express himself and own his individuality at an early age. Shapel was cheerleading competitively for University of Louisville when someone dared him to take the stage as a comedian and he never looked back, dropping out shortly thereafter to pursue a career in stand up full-time. His unique life experiences such as being adopted by a Caucasian family at age 15, his punk rock mentality, and his stage presence make for a truly original voice in the comedy community. Diligence and the desire to grow led Shapel from the Phoenix open mic circuit onto main stages, where he regularly performed for comedians such as Bill Burr, Hannibal Buress, and Brendan Schaub, and is now headlining clubs across the country. Shapel was selected to be a “New Face” at the 2019 Just For Laughs Comedy Festival.

event_description:
Liz Splatt is a cornfed, Austin Texas based comedian thriving in the dirty cracks of the comedy world. Being effortlessly thicc and hilarious her whole life, Liz began her comedy career at a sexy little gas station open mic of Denton Texas. Since moving to Austin Liz has worked with some of the biggest names in comedy and it wasn’t even because they wanted to smash. Liz successfully auditioned to join the first class of Door Guys at Joe Rogan’s Comedy Mothership. Shortly after that Liz Splatt (commonly known as The Splattapuss) won the title of Funniest Comedian in Austin 2024. This opened up the doors to performing in Moontower Comedy Festival 2025. Also in 2025, she was a drop dead killer on the Skankfest Vegas. Liz has also been on Kill Tony many times and is beloved on the show (don’t check reddit). She is the primary feature act on the road for beloved Kill Tony Regular Ari Matti. You may think she's just another loud lady who would be hot for a P.E. coach but Liz Splatt is actually pretty funny, for a girl.

event_description:
Shapel Lacey is a Los Angeles based comedian born and raised in Mesa, Arizona. A diehard punk rocker and former award-winning competitive cheerleader, Shapel found ways to express himself and own his individuality at an early age. Shapel was cheerleading competitively for University of Louisville when someone dared him to take the stage as a comedian and he never looked back, dropping out shortly thereafter to pursue a career in stand up full-time. His unique life experiences such as being adopted by a Caucasian family at age 15, his punk rock mentality, and his stage presence make for a truly original voice in the comedy community. Diligence and the desire to grow led Shapel from the Phoenix open mic circuit onto main stages, where he regularly performed for comedians such as Bill Burr, Hannibal Buress, and Brendan Schaub, and is now headlining clubs across the country. Shapel was selected to be a “New Face” at the 2019 Just For Laughs Comedy Festival.

event_description:
Sophie Buddle is a stand-up, a TV writer, and a podcaster. She has just wrapped as the head monologue writer for “After Midnight with Taylor Tomlinson.” She has also appeared on “The Tonight Show”, “The Late Late Show with James Corden”, and on CBC’s “This Hour Has 22 Minutes as a correspondent and staff writer. She's also been featured on CTV’s "Roast Battle", JFL All Access, Kevin Hart's LOL Network, the Winnipeg Comedy Festival and the Halifax Comedy Festival. She was a featured performer at the Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal and in 2022 had the esteemed privilege of delivering the Canadian Keynote Address on Comedy. Sophie released her first album in 2019, "Lil Bit Of Buddle," which won the 2020 Juno Award for Best Comedy Album of the Year, making her the first female comic to win that award. She released the album herself so you can find it on iTunes in the genre "easy listening", which was a mistake, but it is easy to listen to, so it's OK. Her podcast "Obsessed with Sophie Buddle", which tackles people’s obsessions (from Beyoncé to American politics to checking if the door is locked to revenge) is currently available on Apple Podcasts. She is a three-time runner up (but fourth time’s the charm!) for Canada's biggest stand-up contest, SiriusXM Top Comic, and can currently be seen headlining across the country.

event_description:
Billy Gardell currently stars in the CBS series Bob Hearts Abishola, from award-winning creator, executive producer and writer Chuck Lorre. Bob Hearts Abishola is a love story about a middle-aged compression sock businessman from Detroit who unexpectedly falls for his cardiac nurse, a Nigerian immigrant, while recovering from a heart attack and sets his sights on winning her over. Undaunted by Abishola’s lack of initial interest or the vast differences in their backgrounds, Bob is determined to win Abishola’s heart, in this comedic examination of immigrant life in America.

Prior to BHA, Billy Gardell starred in the CBS hit television series, Mike & Molly as Officer Mike Biggs from 2010-2016. Mike & Molly continues to air in syndication to this day. In addition, he starred as Col. Tom Parker in the CMT series, Sun Records and has had a recurring role on another CBS hit series, Young Sheldon.

In 2016 he received a daytime Emmy nomination as best game show host for Monopoly Millionaires Club.

Before Mike & Molly, Gardell co-starred in the critically acclaimed television series Lucky. His other television credits include Yes Dear and Judging Amy, on the Network, My Name is Earl, The Practice, Monk and Gary the Rat.

He made his major motion picture debut alongside Anthony Quinn and Sylvester Stallone in Avenging Angelo, and had a memorable scene with Billy Bob Thornton in the Cohen Brother’s film Bad Santa. He also appeared in You, Me & Dupree.

As a standup, Gardell took the long road to Hollywood, stopping at every small town lounge, military base and comedy club along the way. His comedy act took him to Los Angeles where his dedication to acting, along with touring as a stand-up comedian, allowed him to grow consistently in both arenas. His stand-up show is a powerhouse. His grounded, down-to-earth point of view strikes a strong chord with American audiences. Stories about his rough childhood, wild adolescence and new family life are executed with the skill of a master craftsman.

As a standup comic, his comedy specials, Billy Gardell: Halftime, premiered on Comedy Central and Billy Gardell Presents Road Dogs premiered on Showtime.

A native of Pittsburgh who currently lives in Los Angeles, Gardell loves Steeler football, stand-up comedy and his wife Patty, and son Will.

event_description:
Join our six week stand up comedy workshop, and develop a 5 minute set that you can perform at open mics and live shows!
Every week will be an interactive workshop that will cover different topics.
This workshop covers:
Stage presence
How to deal with hecklers
Comedy terminology
Writing techniques
Joke structure
Story telling
Finding your “voice”


This course is led by professional stand up comedians with years of experience. The workshop simulates a small show environment that gives each student an opportunity to be on stage each session. The Mic Drop Comedy Workshop is fun, engaging and an amazing resource for anyone looking to start stand up comedy!
For more details please email Jesse Egan @ jesseegancomedy@gmail.com.

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.

event_description:
Billy Gardell currently stars in the CBS series Bob Hearts Abishola, from award-winning creator, executive producer and writer Chuck Lorre. Bob Hearts Abishola is a love story about a middle-aged compression sock businessman from Detroit who unexpectedly falls for his cardiac nurse, a Nigerian immigrant, while recovering from a heart attack and sets his sights on winning her over. Undaunted by Abishola’s lack of initial interest or the vast differences in their backgrounds, Bob is determined to win Abishola’s heart, in this comedic examination of immigrant life in America.

Prior to BHA, Billy Gardell starred in the CBS hit television series, Mike & Molly as Officer Mike Biggs from 2010-2016. Mike & Molly continues to air in syndication to this day. In addition, he starred as Col. Tom Parker in the CMT series, Sun Records and has had a recurring role on another CBS hit series, Young Sheldon.

In 2016 he received a daytime Emmy nomination as best game show host for Monopoly Millionaires Club.

Before Mike & Molly, Gardell co-starred in the critically acclaimed television series Lucky. His other television credits include Yes Dear and Judging Amy, on the Network, My Name is Earl, The Practice, Monk and Gary the Rat.

He made his major motion picture debut alongside Anthony Quinn and Sylvester Stallone in Avenging Angelo, and had a memorable scene with Billy Bob Thornton in the Cohen Brother’s film Bad Santa. He also appeared in You, Me & Dupree.

As a standup, Gardell took the long road to Hollywood, stopping at every small town lounge, military base and comedy club along the way. His comedy act took him to Los Angeles where his dedication to acting, along with touring as a stand-up comedian, allowed him to grow consistently in both arenas. His stand-up show is a powerhouse. His grounded, down-to-earth point of view strikes a strong chord with American audiences. Stories about his rough childhood, wild adolescence and new family life are executed with the skill of a master craftsman.

As a standup comic, his comedy specials, Billy Gardell: Halftime, premiered on Comedy Central and Billy Gardell Presents Road Dogs premiered on Showtime.

A native of Pittsburgh who currently lives in Los Angeles, Gardell loves Steeler football, stand-up comedy and his wife Patty, and son Will.

event_description:
He has been called one of the most original stand-up comics in the country, and his performances leave audiences laughing in tears. Michael Blackson, aka, ‘The African King of Comedy', has been entertaining audiences all across the country and around the globe for more than a decade. Inspired by the stand up comedy of Eddie Murphy, Blackson began to develop his comedic talent in 1992 in the unkind comedy clubs of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Blackson’s comedic appeal grew from his involvement with BET’s ComicView series, HBO’s Def Comedy Jam, Showtime at Harlem, and Live in Hollywood. However, it was in a Los Angeles comedy club where Blackson got his big break. Blackson was performing at the Comedy Store where actor/director Ice Cube was in attendance to see comedian Mike Epps perform. But after experiencing Blackson’s performance, Ice Cube invited the young comic for a reading…and the rest is smash hit history! Blackson’s outstanding and unforgettable performance in the smash hit comedy, Next Friday, drew praise and a fan following like no other.

After his scene stealing performance in Next Friday, fans wanted more, and in 2005, Blackson would not disappoint. He released his top-selling sketch comedy CD entitled, Modasucka, Welcome to America. With Blackson, the work never stops. Along with special guest appearances on some of the hottest music videos, Blackson stole the stage on P. Diddy’s Bad Boys of Comedy on HBO and starred in a commercial for the Chappelle Show on Comedy Central. There’s no mistaking Blackson for any other comedian when he takes the stage.

And what about those Dashikis? When he takes the stage, clad in the finest Dashikis the Motherland has to offer, “The African King of Comedy? is born! Along with his film and television endeavors, Blackson continues to entertain his fans as the headliner for live shows at comedy clubs, universities and special events, bringing his one-of-a kind, must-see stand-up performance to audiences all across the country and around the world.

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.

event_description:
He has been called one of the most original stand-up comics in the country, and his performances leave audiences laughing in tears. Michael Blackson, aka, ‘The African King of Comedy', has been entertaining audiences all across the country and around the globe for more than a decade. Inspired by the stand up comedy of Eddie Murphy, Blackson began to develop his comedic talent in 1992 in the unkind comedy clubs of Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Blackson’s comedic appeal grew from his involvement with BET’s ComicView series, HBO’s Def Comedy Jam, Showtime at Harlem, and Live in Hollywood. However, it was in a Los Angeles comedy club where Blackson got his big break. Blackson was performing at the Comedy Store where actor/director Ice Cube was in attendance to see comedian Mike Epps perform. But after experiencing Blackson’s performance, Ice Cube invited the young comic for a reading…and the rest is smash hit history! Blackson’s outstanding and unforgettable performance in the smash hit comedy, Next Friday, drew praise and a fan following like no other.

After his scene stealing performance in Next Friday, fans wanted more, and in 2005, Blackson would not disappoint. He released his top-selling sketch comedy CD entitled, Modasucka, Welcome to America. With Blackson, the work never stops. Along with special guest appearances on some of the hottest music videos, Blackson stole the stage on P. Diddy’s Bad Boys of Comedy on HBO and starred in a commercial for the Chappelle Show on Comedy Central. There’s no mistaking Blackson for any other comedian when he takes the stage.

And what about those Dashikis? When he takes the stage, clad in the finest Dashikis the Motherland has to offer, “The African King of Comedy? is born! Along with his film and television endeavors, Blackson continues to entertain his fans as the headliner for live shows at comedy clubs, universities and special events, bringing his one-of-a kind, must-see stand-up performance to audiences all across the country and around the world.

No refunds or exchanges.
Fee applies if transferring confirmed ticket purchase to another guest.
Ages 21+

Frankie Marcos is a stand-up comedian from San Jose, California, who headlines internationally. He is the winner of the 2024 San Francisco International Comedy Competition, earning a place in history alongside past finalists including Robin Williams, Ellen DeGeneres, Louis C.K., and more.

Frankie is a regular on Don’t Tell Comedy and Chocolate Sundaes at the Laugh Factory in Hollywood. He has performed at the New York Comedy Festival, Melbourne International Comedy Festival, and the Edinburgh Fringe Festival. His Adelaide Fringe show earned a 5-star review and a sold-out show, and he has had multiple sold-out shows at the Melbourne International Comedy Festival.

Across social media, Frankie reaches over 10 million viewers monthly and has built an audience of 220,000+ followers across platforms. His content has been featured by Power 106, 106 KMEL, 99.7 NOW, Australia’s news.com.au, and multiple times by the Daily Mail.

event_description:
Bo Johnson is a comedian from Seattle, Washington. Most recently he released his first full length special, “Two Sailboats” in 2025. He can be found headlining clubs, breweries, and appropriately sized theaters across the United States and Canada. His stand up has been featured on Netflix is a Joke Radio, The SF Sketchfest Dozen, season two of Kevin Hart Presents: Hart of the City on Comedy Central, Don’t Tell Comedy Secret Sets (twice), Hulu, & LOL Live! at the prestigious Just For Laughs comedy festival in Montreal. He was a finalist in the 39th annual Seattle International Comedy Competition and is a regular at festivals including Bumbershoot, SF Sketchfest, the Double Down Comedy Experience sponsored by Zappos, Life is Beautiful in Las Vegas, Rifflandia in Victoria BC, Prizefest, and Big Pine Comedy Festival in Phoenix. Bo has opened for major acts including Marc Maron, Joe Dombrowski, Jessica Kirson, and David Nihill. With a growing online audience Bo’s jokes have been viewed millions of times online.

Separate from stand up comedy, one time Bo and his best friend from high school snuck into a movie theater as one person. That video was broadcast on TV shows like the now cancelled Caught on Camera with Nick Cannon on NBC and the lowest rated daytime talk show at the time, The Meredith Veira Show. Bo still gets messages each year from friends seeing the video go viral on different meme accounts. Numerous magazines and newspapers also wrote about the hijinks, including an article in Cosmopolitan titled, “Man Sneaks His BFF Into Movie Theater by Stuffing Him Into His Pants.” More recently Bo trained his roommates dog by walking her to Shania Twain's "Man! I feel like a Woman!" in a viral stunt earning over 7 millions views on Tik Tok and press coverage in both major and incredibly minor publications.

Last year Michael Palascak appeared on Nateland Presents: The Showcase on YouTube. You can also find him on Paramount + where his debut half hour is streaming on Season 1, Episode 2 of Comedy Central’s The Half Hour and on CBS on an upcoming episode of Comics Unleashed. Michael grew up in a small town in Indiana and began doing stand-up in Chicago after his parents moved the family to the suburbs during his formative years. Drew Hunt of The Chicago Reader writes about Michael’s stand-up, “In a lot of ways, he represents the ideal antidote to the sort of unbridled cynicism that pervades much of contemporary stand-up.” The Guardian writes, “In stand up, there is the writing, and then there is the performing. This guy nails both… clean, clever, dark and, most importantly, funny.” As a clean comedian, he has racked up multiple late night credits with appearances on The Tonight Show, The Late Show, The Late Late Show, and Conan. Additionally, he was a Top 5 Finalist on the last season of Last Comic Standing after eliminating Taylor Tomlinson in a head-to-head stand-up competition where one judge claimed, “My first impression of Michael was a great likability. This is a guy that could star in a sitcom.” Michael currently resides in California and is a dad. Every Monday night he records a podcast after his kid goes to sleep. It is called I Just Got My Kid To Sleep.

event_description:
Gary Conrad is one of the most skilled and experienced comedy-hypnotists working. He has consistently amazed audiences from Alaska to Florida with his hilarious shows. He has become a regular at many "A" room comedy clubs; colleges & high schools; and corporate & charitable events across the country.

Gary Conrad was born in Elizabeth, New Jersey. After receiving his degree from Furman University in Greenville, South Carolina, he worked as a stockbroker in New York City. He followed that with a very successful eleven-year stretch in the shipping business, working in both New York and Los Angeles, while an officer in the US Army Reserve. He now resides in Chapin, SC.

Gary began his journey into hypnosis in order to better condition himself during his physical training. He learned that through control of his mind, he could maximize his workout abilities. This ignited a passion for hypnotism that continues to this day. After several years of study, Gary began hypnotizing people clinically in a World Trade Center office and eventually moved to the stage. He has hypnotized thousands, from retirees to British nurses to bikers to New York policemen to college students. He was bitten by the “show-business bug” while pursuing an MBA in Finance.

His shows are among the most popular that many comedy clubs host. Oftentimes, this show has the same people come back two and three times in one week to attend. Also, while traversing the country, Gary has become popular on radio and television programs in many different markets. He works non-stop...year round.

event_description:
Jessica “Jess Hilarious” Moore is an American stand-up comedian, actress, voice artist, and media personality whose career spans digital content, television, live performance, and national radio. Born and raised in Baltimore, Maryland, Moore first gained
widespread attention by creating viral comedy skits on social media, especially her popular segment “Jess With the Mess,” where her sharp observations and relatable humor quickly built a large following, with over 8.5 million followers across her personal
platforms and over 4.4 million following The Breakfast Club podcast where Jess co-hosts, totaling to a reach of over 13 million.

Jess’s early success on social platforms paved the way for her stand-up career, where she has toured nationally and opened for established comedians, earning a reputation for candid, high energy performances. She transitioned to television as a series
lead role on the Fox sitcom Rel, and frequent appearances on shows such as The Nick Cannon Show, MTV’s Wild ‘N Out, BET’s Black Card Revoked, All Def Comedy on HBO, and The Real Daytime Talk Show.

In addition to her comedy and acting work, Jess has expanded her voice acting portfolio with contributions to Kevin Harts animated series The Lil Kev Show on BET, further broadening her presence across entertainment formats. In 2024, Jess Hilarious became the third co-host of The Breakfast Club, the Hall of Fame nationally syndicated morning show on iHeartMedia joining hosts Charlamagne tha God and DJ Envy, with 3 million monthly listeners and airing on 100+ radio stations across the United States, surpassing 1 billion downloads across podcast platforms in June 2025 and now airing every day in video format on Netflix since January 2026.

Across platforms, Jess Hilarious continues to blend comedy, commentary, and cultural relevance, solidifying her role as one of the most dynamic entertainers working today. Whether she’s cracking up crowds, hosting conversations that shape culture, or making waves across screens big and small, Jess Hilarious is redefining what it means to be a modern comedic powerhouse—always real, always bold, and always hilarious.

event_description:
Adele Givens is a powerhouse comedian known for her razor-sharp wit, fearless delivery, and unapologetic authenticity. With a voice that blends elegance, edge, and real-life truth, she commands every stage she steps on—leaving audiences crying with laughter and quoting her long after the show ends.

Best known for her iconic appearances on Def Comedy Jam, as well as All Stars of Def Comedy Jam and Bad Girls of Def Comedy Jam, Adele has solidified her place as one of the most respected and recognizable voices in stand-up. Showcasing not only her comedic brilliance but also her versatility as a spoken word artist, she has also appeared on Def Poetry Jam.

Her television presence extends far beyond stand-up, with appearances on major shows including The Oprah Winfrey Show, The Tracy Ullman Show, The Steve Harvey Show, Martin, Moesha, and The Parkers. She also held a recurring role on The Hughleys, further showcasing her range as a performer, and starred in her own sitcom pilot, The Adele Givens Show.

Adele’s impact extends to critically acclaimed projects, including her performance in The Queens of Comedy, which earned a Grammy nomination, solidifying her as a standout voice among comedy’s elite. She has also headlined her own HBO half-hour comedy special, further cementing her status as a premier stand-up talent.

On the big screen, Adele has brought her unforgettable presence to films such as The Players Club, Too Many Christmases, and Beauty Shop. Beyond television and film, she has also connected with audiences over the airwaves, hosting a morning radio show on Chicago’s WGCI 107.5 FM.

Her unforgettable catchphrase, “I’m such a fu@kin’ lady!”, perfectly captures her comedic persona: bold, confident, and always in control. Whether she’s headlining comedy clubs across the country or lighting up screens big and small, Adele brings a level of honesty and charisma that few can match.

With decades in the game and a legacy still growing, Adele Givens continues to prove that real comedy doesn’t hold back—it tells the truth, and it does it with style.

King Bo is a stand-up comedian and digital creator known for his fearless storytelling, high energy delivery, and wildly relatable takes on dating, friendships, and everyday chaos. His comedy blends sharp observations with real-life experiences, delivered with a larger-than life personality that has made him a favorite both online and on stage.

Bo first gained widespread attention through viral comedy sketches and character-driven videos that quickly built him a loyal fanbase of millions across social media. What started as digital momentum has rapidly translated into a growing live audience, with Bo performing to sold-out crowds at venues across the country including headline shows at The Lodge Room in Los Angeles and City Winery.

event_description:
Vinny Guadagnino is one of the most recognized lifestyle personalities and digital influencers. Vinny first rose to fame in 2009 on the MTV series “Jersey Shore,” which over its six-season run became the highest-rated series in the history of the network and a cultural phenomenon. During his time away from the shore, Vinny starred in series including “Vinny & Ma Eat America” on Food Network and “Joking Off” on MTV2. In April 2018, the franchise returned as “Jersey Shore: Family Vacation,” and immediately recaptured the zeitgeist, breaking viewership records along the way. The show’s 7th season is set to premiere on February 8th, 2024.

In addition, Vinny has starred in MTV’s “Double Shot at Love,” and “Revenge Prank,” with Pauly D. Vinny also has a residency at the world-famous Chippendales Las Vegas, where he serves as the celebrity guest host throughout the year.

In 2022, Vinny joined the historic 31st season of Dancing with the Stars. Vinny and his partner Koko made an impressive run on the show, making it all the way to the quarter-finals!

Most recently, Vinny joined the cast of “All-Star Shore” on MTV & Paramount+ for its second season. In this series, Vinny went head-to-head against eleven other reality stars doing what he does best – party games!

The Keto Guido continues to build a massive social media presence, working with brands like Visible, La Roche-Posay & DraftKings, while also staring in Wawa’s newest social media campaign/commercial promoting their pizza.

Off-screen, Vinny is a 2x best-selling author. His most recent book, “The Keto Guido Cookbook: Delicious Recipes to Get Healthy and Look Great” lead to Vinny becoming one of the most known personalities in the Keto/Health & Wellness and fitness communities. You can see some of his recipes featured on his Keto Instagram page @KetoGuido.

event_description:
Kelly Kellz (Kelly Davis) is a dynamic comedian and actress whose infectious humor and grounded storytelling have made her a standout voice in modern stand-up. Born and raised in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Kelly started her professional journey far from the comedy club — she was a certified K–12 teacher, shaping young minds before she ever picked up a mic. Her comedy career officially launched in 2009, and she quickly built a following with her relatable material, drawing on her real-life experiences juggling motherhood, marriage, and the everyday trials of Black womanhood. In 2017, Kelly made her television debut on HBO’s All Def Comedy, a major milestone that marked her rise beyond the local circuit. Since then, she’s shared the stage with comedy legends like Dick Gregory, Mike Epps, Rickey Smiley, and Katt Williams. Kelly’s talent isn’t confined to stand-up. She’s appeared in film too — with credits like Disconnection and Role Play. Meanwhile, her “Funny By Nature” tour (executive produced by Vivica A. Fox) has taken her across the country, delighting audiences from coast to coast. Off-stage, Kelly is a powerhouse on social media, with millions of followers across platforms. She also co-hosts the Through Thick & Thin podcast, where she tackles life, family, and the funny chaos in between. In 2024, she was honored as Comedian of the Year by the Association of the Promotion of Campus Activities (APAC), a testament to both her talent and wide-reaching appeal. Kelly Kellz is more than a comedian — she’s a storyteller, a mother, a former teacher, and an inspiration. Her journey from Milwaukee classrooms to national stages underscores her commitment to making people laugh while staying true to her roots.

No refunds or exchanges.

event_description:
Jared Freid is a stand-up comedian, podcaster and author based out of New York City. His most recent stand up special, “37 & Single” premiered on Netflix in 2023 to rave reviews and rose to the Top 10 most watched TV in the US and Canada on Netflix. In addition, The New York Times touted “In the crowded field of dating jokes, Jared Freid…distinguishes himself...”. With a strong focus on dating and relationships, Jared’s comedy reflects the ordinary daily thoughts of everyone you know, especially if you know a lot of millennials that are obsessing over dating apps, trying to be real adults, and worrying about their bodies.

In June 2026, Jared had his first book, “Walking Red Flag, Dating Advice From Your Favorite Guy Friend” published by Simon & Schuster. PEOPLE magazine described the book as offering "brutally honest" dating advice and highlighted its blend of comedy with practical guidance, while Publishers Weekly called the book a "friendly and refreshingly blunt resource for exhausted daters" and praised Freid for bringing "welcome levity to his generally sound advice" on relationships and communication.

Jared has appeared on a number of television programs over the years including multiple appearances on “The Tonight Show” and as a regular contributor on “Good Morning Football” on the NFL Network. He recently made a guest appearance on ABC’s the "Golden Bachelor" where he hosted a group date roast of the Bachelor, Mel Owens. Jared also voiced the comedic narrator role on Peacock’s popular reality show “Love Under Cover” and he can be seen in the independent romantic comedy “31 Candles.”

In addition to his hectic touring schedule, Jared hosts two highly rated weekly podcasts including his “JTrain Podcast”. The show has a cult following of loyal fans. Guests have included: Michael Che, Pete Davidson, Colin Quinn, Sal Vulcano, Bert Kreischer, Dave Attell, Michelle Wolf and more. It’s been called “A Dear Abby for Dudes,” which is why both men and women tune in religiously. Many of Jared’s fans say that his advice has helped them in their personal lives. Jared also co-hosts the popular podcast “U Up?” with Jordana Abraham of Betches, where they discuss their takes on modern dating with issues ranging from apps to hookups to relationships.

In 2019, Jared released his first full-length comedy album “Always a Momma Bear” through Virtual Comedy Network. The album debuted at #1 on the iTunes Comedy Charts. Jared was also named a New Face of Comedy at the Just For Laugh’s comedy festival in 2017.

Jared is currently on his The Table For One Tour. For additional information, please visit jaredfreid.com.

event_description:
Marcus D. Wiley is a premiere entertainer whose class of comedy surpasses the status quo. In February 2025, Marcus released his third hour special, “Marriage Is Major Surgery”, which was executive produced by Ali Siddiq and is available on YouTube. The special went viral and received over 6 million views to date. This one-of-a-kind performance has been described as ‘ideal for the married, the wanna be married, the used to be married and the wanna be married again’. In February 2026, Marcus released his 4th special Rehab, again executive produced by Ali Siddiq and available on YouTube.

The son of a preacher, Marcus’ charismatic style of delivery is clean, captivating, funny and knowledgeable. He provides lots of laughter along with a guaranteed message on being a better you. His motto for his brand of comedy is “Laughter is good, but the Message is better!” Wooing the masses, Marcus’ widespread appeal is contemporary enough to entice the fashion-savvy and culturally conscious Generation Xs, Ys, and Zs, but traditional enough to melt the matriarch’s heart as he recounts Mama’s mandates.

Prior to his comedy career, Marcus was a professor at Texas Southern University. A three-time college graduate with an Associates Degree in Fine Art Theatre, Bachelor’s Degree in Radio/TV Film and Master’s Degree in Communications, Marcus is also a published author. His book Hustle & Faith remains a top-selling piece of literature and excerpts from the book are often quoted from the pulpit to the streets. His motto as an author is “God will honor your faith and reward your hustle.”

event_description:
Jay Yoder is a nationally touring stand-up comedian, speaker, and creator of the viral Cheer Dad persona that has become a favorite among cheer parents, coaches, and gym owners across North America.

With more than 80,000 followers and millions of monthly views across social media, Jay hilariously captures the world of competitive cheer—from the chaos of tryouts and callbacks to long weekends at competitions and the unforgettable personalities that make the sport so unique.

A former educator with over 20 years of experience, Jay blends sharp observational humor with heartfelt stories about parenting and family life, including raising his autistic daughter.

Jay tours nationally with the Bored Teachers Comedy Tour and has shared the stage with Joe Gatto.

Bring It On with Cheer Dad Jay Yoder & Friends is a laugh-filled night created for cheer moms, dads, coaches, gym owners, and former athletes. If you've survived tryouts, evaluations, and weekends spent in convention centers, this show is your well-deserved night out.

Wayans can next be seen in September 2025 starring in the psychological horror thriller “Him” from Universal Pictures and Jordan Peele’s Monkeypaw banner. Wayans is commonly recognized for his role as ‘Marcus Copeland’ in Columbia Pictures’ 2004 hit comedy classic “White Chicks” opposite Shawn Wayans and directed by Keenen Ivory Wayans. His other hit films include “Scary Movie” and “Scary Movie 2, “Requiem for a Dream,” “Respect,” “Fifty Shades Of Black,” “Little Man,” “A Haunted House” and “A Haunted House 2,” “Naked,” “Sextuplets,” “The Curse of Bridge Hollow,” “Air,” “On The Rocks,” and “Don't Be a Menace to South Central While Drinking Your Juice in the Hood,” among others. His TV credits include The WB’s “The Wayans Bros.,” which was the highest rated comedy on the network and continues to air in syndication, the NBC sitcom “Marlon,” “Fox’s “In Living Color” and “Bel-Air.”

event_description:
Ever since New York native Aries Spears was 14 years old, he has been a force to be reckoned with in the comedy scene throughout America. His quick wit, charisma and ferociously aggressive style of comedy have earned him critical acclaim, high accolades, and above all, a busy schedule. From being a regular on Fox’s Mad TV, starring in feature films, appearing on a number of national talk shows, and continually touring the country where he continually sells out each and every city, Aries’ talents are widespread as he just passed the 3 million spins played on Pandora and his podcast is one of the "Musts" in the US.

This past summer, Aries guest starred in CNN’s “See It Loud” new summer series on the history of Black Television which was one of their hit docuseries of 2023, alongside Amanda Seales,Da’Vinchi, Debbie Allen, Deon Cole, Desus & Mero, Gabrielle Union, Jimmie Walker, Judge GregMathis, Kevin Frazier, Loni Love, Lynn Whitfield, Mo’Nique, Naturi Naughton, Omari Hardwick,Ray J, Ruben Studdard, Sherri Shepherd, Tatyana Ali, Tiffany Pollard, Tisha Campbell, Vivica A. Fox and many more. Trailer: https://tinyurl.com/AriesCNNSeeItLoud

As a principal cast member on Fox’s hit sketch comedy show Mad TV, Aries brought a fresh, hip style to the already-edgy program from the third through the tenth season. The producers made full use of many of Aries’s talents by calling on him frequently to create new hilarious characters and write sketches where he thrived for eight seasons.

Some of the many recurring characters that Aries is famous for on the show include: Belma Buttons, Bill Cosby, Jesse Jackson, Mike Tyson, Walter (Crackheads), Reggie (Erascist), Dollar Bill Montgomery, Shaquille O'Neal, The Klumps, Michael Jackson, Sisqo, Evander Holyfield, El Diablo Negro and more. Aries also boasts a number of uproarious impersonations on the show that include James Brown, Al Pacino, and his childhood idol Eddie Murphy. The Aries-branded sketch “Talkin’ American” was Mad TV’s most popular bit, keeping fans tuned in and boosting Mad’s ratings impressively on Saturday night.

Aries has also found great success in the world of feature films. At the age of 17, after being spotted in a comedy club, Aries landed a part in the movie Home of Angels which eventually led to a starring role alongside John Leguizamo in TriStar’s The Pest followed by the notable role as Cuba Gooding, Jr.’s brother in Columbia’s blockbuster hit, Jerry Maguire.

Aries’ fierce momentum paved the way from features to tv and his eight seasons on Mad TV . Aries continues to spread his comedic wings with the development of feature film projects -- in addition to TV -- which he is currently involved in writing. He is presently developing a feature project based on an original character that he created on Mad TV, as well as a thriller about a young black man immersed in hip-hop culture. Additionally, Aries has made appearances on many talk shows including: Loveline, Vibe, Keenen Ivory Wayans, Soul Train and Late Friday. He has also lent his voice to an animated character on C-Bear and Jamal and had a recurring stint on Fox’s The Best Damn Sports Show Period, where he created some of the show’s funniest characters during his short time there.

Aries maintains a strong connection to his African roots and is involved in many charitable events, including a number of organizations that help abused women. He feels blessed to have been able to achieve everything that he has, but he in no way intends on stopping there. Given the extreme growing success rate of action comedies coming out of Hollywood, it’s safe to say that Aries Spears will be in demand for quite some time.
